package.name: franka_streaming_impedance_client
package.description:
Producer-side helpers for franka_streaming_impedance_controller: builds the absolutely-timed MultiDOFJointTrajectory chunks the controller splices on, and wraps the publisher so a producer can tell whether the controller is actually subscribed.
Pure Python and ROS-message-only, so it installs into any workspace on any distro the controller itself builds against.
